learning_outcomes.text: Has gained knowledge and skills in manufacturing method selection.
Can design the shaping process steps with casting methods. Can select the appropriate casting method for the part.

Can select the appropriate welding method for the welded manufacturing of a part. Can select process parameters and equipment for successful manufacturing with welding methods. Can perform process planning for brazing and gluing operations.

Can design the process steps for a part to be shaped by machining. Has gained the ability to select work-holding equipment, cutting tools, and process variables in manufacturing with machining methods. Can perform cost analysis.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to manufacturing methods. Introduction to casting method. Melting and furnaces.
Sand molding methods, sand mold materials and properties, patterns, cores.
Plaster mold casting, ceramic precision mold casting, permanent mold casting, low-pressure die casting, high-pressure die casting and centrifugal casting.
Solidification, Finishing processes, Quality control, Casting defects, Casting part design principles
Introduction to welding methods. Principles of welding methods
Oxy-fuel welding, Principles of arc welding methods.
Non-consumable electrode arc welding methods, Solid-state welding methods, Advanced welding methods, Brazing, Adhesion methods, Welding defects
Introduction to machining and principles of machining
Drilling, Boring, Reaming, Broaching and Milling
Grinding, Honing, Lapping, Variables affecting machining and calculation of machining time
